source_problem: The projection of SalesLineItem.Subamount is declared Set(Real), leaving a collection-kind inconsistency with duplicate-preserving charging per sales line.
approved_preconditions: The current Sale exists, is incomplete, and is not yet ready for payment.
approved_postconditions: The Sale amount becomes the sum of the subtotal of every associated sales line.
Distinct sales lines with equal subtotals each contribute; subtotals are not deduplicated by numeric value.
When there are no sales lines, the Sale amount becomes zero.
The Sale becomes ready for payment.
The operation returns the resulting Sale amount.
correction_scope: Specify duplicate-preserving aggregation by SalesLineItem identity. Replace, rather than increment, the Sale amount with this total. Preserve the preconditions, payment-ready update and numeric return type.
